notes.title: V0.62.18 update content
notes.notes: [p]1. Fixed the issue where scrolling with the mouse wheel on certain panels would unintentionally scroll the scene.  [/p][p]2. Adjusted the mood value settings: characters will only become unhappy if their mood drops below 0, and they will only break down if it falls below 50.  [/p][p]3. Optimized the logic for news programs—high-trending materials will now be prioritized for selection.  [/p][p]4. Fixed a bug where the viewership range of AI-controlled TV stations could exceed the upper limit.  [/p][p]5. Resolved the issue where the "Resume Interrupted Production" feature could cause multiple studios to work on the same program simultaneously, leading to chaos.  [/p][p]6. Fixed bugs related to directly firing or reassigning employees from the think tank, which caused various issues.  [/p][p]7. Adjusted the position of the "Set to Idle" button to prevent accidental clicks.  [/p][p]8. Fixed several bugs associated with the "Set to Idle" functionality.[/p]

notes.title: V0.62.17 update content
notes.notes: [p]1. Fix the bug where a red warning window frequently pops up when producing TV series sequels.  [/p][p]2. Add a "Return to Main Menu" button in the ESC menu.  [/p][p]3. For unexpectedly interrupted projects, add a button in the new project interface to resume production with a single click.  [/p][p]4. Automatically pause the game upon entry (only for players who have not started the tutorial).  [/p][p]5. Add a "Set Employee to Idle" button in the personnel management interface (hovering over the employee's button will display it). This feature involves complex logic, and its stability is still under testing. If you encounter any bugs related to this function, please join the developer's group to provide feedback!  [/p]

notes.title: V0.62.15 update content
notes.notes: [p]1. Add the function of deleting programs by right click for scheduling table  [/p][p]2. Optimize the display of employee attribute panel, attributes important to the occupation will be highlighted with yellow background. Note: Each profession has only about 6 main attributes that are useful for its professional business and will participate in the ability rating, other attributes only need to be referred to when special jobs are to be arranged. [/p][p]3. Lower the requirements for unlocking Star Agent and TV series production  [/p][p]4. Fix some bugs  Translated with DeepL.com (free version)[/p]

notes.title: V0.62.4 (Job Transfer Edition) update content
notes.notes: [p]1. Fix the problem that the input number conflicts with the accelerator key when the studio is renamed.[/p][p][/p][p]2. Add a one-click empty button to the resume of the personnel department.[/p][p][/p][p]3. Fix an old bug that the supervisor can't delete.[/p][p][/p][p]4. The process of program production is adjusted. At present, the director does not need to go over to check in the preparation stage, which will save a lot of time, especially for larger studios or projects.[/p][p][/p][p]5. Fixed a bug of pathfinding error when there was no space around the super-large studio.[/p][p][/p][p]6. I made a short strategy for TV series. How to speed up and improve the quality of the script?[/p][p][/p][p]7. Click on the personnel of the personnel department and the outsourcing department to view the details.[/p][p][/p][p]8. Employees are allowed to change jobs. Click the switch button on the right side of the main skill, and they can be converted into all non-miscellaneous professions. Although employees can be converted into singers and actors, this version does not support debut, because it is necessary to complete the restrictions on employees turning into stars and related gameplay.[/p]

notes.title: V0.61.3 Update
notes.notes:
1、Fix the bug that the bubble still exists after the job fair ends occasionally.
2、Screening panel adds screening according to ability level (input F-S).
3、When batch operation is performed, it will not cut to all personnel.
4. Optimize the logic of batch operation, now you can select regardless of whether you are free or not.

notes.title: V0.61.2 Update
notes.notes:
1、Fixed the bug that the star may still be stuck in the same place after participating in the training and withdrawing the course (the fix of this bug temporarily prohibits AI from inviting the star to shoot the program)
2、Fixed the problem of displaying the actual effect of corporate culture
3、Recruitment optimization: increase the probability of recruiting high-level employees with the increase of TV station level, and make it possible to get A-level or above employees under high-level TV stations.
4. Unlock a first-person roaming function when the TV station is unlocked at level 2.
5、Fix the bug that the outsourcing tips are not cleared after being done.
6. Add the display of vehicle utilization in the logistics department.

notes.title: V0.61.0 Update
notes.notes:
1、Optimize the recruitment algorithm of the personnel department to improve the probability of recruiting low-grade officers.
2、Add “competence certification” parameter to the screening.
3、Add batch processing, batch dismissal and salary adjustment.
4、Fix the problem of incorrect display of the total number of employees in the staff management interface.
5、Fix the bug that when selling programs in the copyright center, no matter how much the price is set, the programs may be sold.
6、Fix the bug that an investment meeting will suddenly disappear when it is in progress, and optimize the UI layout of the investment meeting.
